canDoYue: 你識叫燕麥奶少糖拿鐵、揀大杯拎走、講個名 Cleo，杯整好先發現係牛奶，再叫店員用燕麥奶整過。
canDoEn: Order a tall to-go latte with oat milk and less sugar, give the name Cleo before it is made, and ask for a remake when the finished cup has dairy.

dialogue.speaker: cleo
dialogue.text: Hi there. Can I order one latte with oat milk and less sugar please?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我可唔可以叫一杯燕麥奶、少糖嘅拿鐵？
dialogue.say: Hi there. Can I order one latte with oat milk and less sugar please?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Sure. Would you like that latte in a tall cup, or a smaller cup?
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。呢杯拿鐵要大杯定細杯？
dialogue.say: Sure. Would you like that latte in a tall cup, or a smaller cup?

dialogue.speaker: cleo
dialogue.text: A tall one, and to go please. The name on the cup is Cleo.
dialogue.glossYue: 要大杯，拎走。個名係 Cleo。
dialogue.say: A tall one, and to go please. The name on the cup is Cleo.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Cleo on a tall to-go cup. I'll make that drink with oat milk.
dialogue.glossYue: Cleo，大杯拎走。我而家用燕麥奶整。
dialogue.say: Cleo on a tall to-go cup. I'll make that drink with oat milk.

dialogue.speaker: cleo
dialogue.text: Oh no. This finished drink has dairy, not the oat milk I asked for.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思。呢杯整好嘅係牛奶，唔係我要嘅燕麥奶。
dialogue.say: Oh no. This finished drink has dairy, not the oat milk I asked for.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Sorry about that mix. I will remake this drink now using oat milk only.
dialogue.glossYue: 搞錯咗，唔好意思。我會用燕麥奶整過呢杯。
dialogue.say: Sorry about that mix. I will remake this drink now using oat milk only.

dialogue.speaker: cleo
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please keep less sugar on the remake of this tall drink too.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。整過嗰杯都要少糖。
dialogue.say: Thank you. Please keep less sugar on the remake of this tall drink too.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes. The name Cleo is on this cup, and the less sugar stays too.
dialogue.glossYue: 好。Cleo 個名寫喺呢杯，少糖保持。
dialogue.say: Yes. The name Cleo is on this cup, and the less sugar stays too.
